blocks.title: Linear search
blocks.text: Linear search list ki har cheez shuru se ek ek kar ke dekhti hai, jab tak matlooba cheez na mile ya list khatam na ho.

items: Har cheez jaanchein: matlooba cheez se muwazna karein.
Mel na ho to agli par jayein.
Cheez milne ya list khatam hone tak dohrayein.

blocks.text: [Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Faisalabad] mein Islamabad dhoondna: Karachi nahi, Lahore nahi, teesri jaanch par Islamabad mil gaya. Agar Islamabad list mein na hota to nateeja nikalne se pehle tamam shehar dekhe jate. Linear search O(n) hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
def linear_search(items, target):
....for i in range(len(items)):
........if items[i] == target:
............return i    # position found
....return -1           # not in the list

print(linear_search(["Karachi", "Lahore", "Islamabad", "Faisalabad"], "Islamabad"))    # 2

blocks.prompt: Faisalabad dhoondne aur yeh tay karne ke liye ke Quetta nahi hai, linear search kitne muwazne karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Faisalabad ke liye chaar (aakhri cheez) aur Quetta ke liye chaar (har cheez jaanchi).

items: Linear search: tarteeb se cheezein jaancho; be-tarteeb list par chalti hai; O(n).
